title: PostgreSQL backup recovery
content: PostgreSQL backup recovery uses an encrypted pg_dump archive. A restore test runs on an isolated temporary database. Never restore a test archive over the running application database.

title: Database incident runbook
content: When the database is unavailable the API readiness returns 503. Liveness stays healthy. Check the database container and disk space, restart the database, then verify readiness and retrieval.

title: Observability metrics logs
content: Prometheus collects request rate, error rate and latency metrics. Grafana displays the dashboard. Alloy ships structured API request logs to Loki without recording document contents.
